g.text: I ran 4 parallel agents in my project yesterday. It was wonderful. Microservices, I'm leaving you.
IT'S A WHOLE NEW WORLD UP HERE!
BUT HOW ARE YOU NOT CONFLICTING?
I JUST RAN A PURE STDLIB SCRIPT:
FLOCK FOR FILES, JSON SSOT FOR MEMORY.
BUT I THINK THIS IS THE FLOCK.
